title: Perfect Acceptance Characterizes Odd Parity
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ map the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to $\\{-1,1\\}$. The odd BLR test accepts $f$ with probability one if and only if there is a subset $S\\subseteq[n]$ of odd cardinality such that $f(x)=\\prod_{i\\in S}x_i$ for every $x\\in\\{-1,1\\}^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
